description: Na₃WO₄ is Enargite structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.36 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.40 Å. W is bonded to four O atoms to form WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with twelve NaO₄ tetrahedra. All W-O bond lengths are 1.89 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form corner-sharing ONa₃W tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form corner-sharing ONa₃W tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form corner-sharing ONa₃W tetrahedra.
